title: UFO Town
description: In the 1990s, a VHS tape emerged along with a claim that a UFO had crashed in a field near Ottawa.

title: Alien Files Reopened
description:
S01 E01 — Summer of the Saucers
In the summer of 1952, stories of U.S. Air Force jets chasing UFOs over the White House knock the Korean War off the front pages of newspapers; as rumors spread, President Harry S. Truman demands to know what was flying over his house.

title: Alien Files Reopened
description:
S01 E02 — The Tall Whites
A young recruit encounters aliens in the Nevada desert in the 1960s; he claims they were working with the US military and housed a spaceship in a secret hangar nearby.

title: Alien Files Reopened
description:
S01 E03 — Billy Meir, The Plejaren and the Multiverse
Billy Meier claims he's traveled through time and space with an alien race from the Pleiades star cluster; in the decades following his revelation, both skeptics and ufologists say it's a hoax despite Meier providing photographic evidence.

title: Alien Files Reopened
description:
S01 E04 — Paul Bennewitz and Project Seven Lambs

title: Close Encounters
description:
S02 E07

title: Close Encounters
description:
S02 E08
In Brazil, three men escape a close encounter that lasted hours longer than they realized; in Canada, a thirteen-year-old boy is blinded temporally after investigating a bizarre object near his home.

title: Close Encounters
description:
S02 E09
A father and son see mysterious lights near their property and call the sheriff's office; Six police cars try to chase down the object; A large craft covers a French town in an odd material.

title: Close Encounters
description:
S02 E10

title: Close Encounters

title: Haunted Hospitals
description:
S04 E01 — Terror in the Sanitorium, The Break Room, Do Not Enter
A medical assistant starting a job in a former TB hospital discovers she's not alone in the building; a rookie nurse takes her break in a room rumored to be haunted; a procedural nurse encounters a hostile entity within the walls of an old hospital.

title: Haunted Hospitals
description:
S04 E02 — The Gift, Room 19, The Cooler
An orderly discovers his frightening gift for seeing spirits of the recently deceased and sensing those who are about to die; a hospice nurse realizes the end-of-life facility where she works is haunted by multiple spirits, including a black dog.

title: Haunted Hospitals
description:
S04 E03 — The Malevolent Boy, Cat
A nurse in Texas discovers her hospital is haunted by a mischievous boy whose pranks become increasingly malicious; a cook at a county hospital witnesses paranormal events in connection with the long-time janitor.

title: Haunted Hospitals
description:
S04 E04 — Creature, The Vigil, The Exorcist
A nurse aide discovers that her care facility contains a horrific creature that threatens her elderly patients; encounters in the hospital halls with a nefarious crone compels a teenager to hold vigil by her dying grandmother's bedside.

title: Haunted Hospitals
description:
S04 E06 — What Comes Around, This Is Where It Feeds, The Boy With the Ball

title: Haunted Hospitals
description:
S04 E07 — Good Vs. Evil, The Haunting

description:

description:

title: Haunted Discoveries: Family Spirits
description:
S02 E06 — A Spirit's Return
Leitreanna, a lifelong practitioner of Seminole spiritualism, believes she is visited by her departed father as she endures an operation, seeing him comfort her when she is in pain.

title: Haunted Discoveries: Family Spirits
description:
S02 E07 — The Pact
Stacy began to mend the relationship she had with her mom following her cancer diagnosis; her mother succumbed to her illness, she believes a number of paranormal occurrences are a testament to the love they have for each other.

title: Haunted Discoveries: Family Spirits
description:
S02 E08 — Ancestral Watchers
Jessica recounts how as a child, she was visited nightly by Abraham Lincoln and a woman in a herringbone dress; Jessica was shocked, however, to learn the true identities of these figures after her mother cracked open a family album.

title: Haunted Discoveries

The House That Chose Us
Kaitlin, who wishes to see her mother after her passing, finally has that wish fulfilled; she soon learned that this experience was only one leg of her family's strange paranormal journey, dating back to her childhood.
